thread:
Maya Chen: Need a tight launch kit for the webinar next Thurs. Deliverables: benchmark hero slide, comparative chart (redwood vs open models), 3 micro tiles (latency/cost/reliability), a single-slide lead-routing template, and a one-page PDF summary for sales. Low-fi comps first.

Riley (design-ops): I can do low-fi comps. Timeline: 48h for first pass. Which data points should the comparative chart show?

Kam (product): Chart columns: model, p95 latency, tokens/sec, unit cost estimate (typical), quantization level. We'll provide a CSV. Keep axis labels simple and use brand-safe colors.

Diego (demand-gen): Social sizes: 1080x1080 and 1200x628. For paid, need muted bg variant and a GIF of the chart reveal (1.5s). Also request a short explainer caption for paid ads.

Riley (design-ops): Noted. I'll provide Figma frames with motion layers separated. Format exports: PNG @2x, SVG, PPTX slide, and a 1-page PDF. Will include alt text and a localization CSV (EN/FR/DE).

Maya Chen: Copy drafts (feel free to tighten):
- Hero headline A: "Inference costs down, latency predictable"
- Hero headline B: "Ship LLM features with predictable economics"
- Tile Latency: "p95 latency ~20ms (typical)"
- Tile Cost: "Unit cost about $0.10 / 1k tokens (typical)"
- Tile Reliability: "Target SLA 99.9%"
Landing: /webinar/inference-playbook/register (gated)
Routing rule: if work_email && company_size >= 200 -> enterprise_queue else inbound_queue.

Legal Bot: Use qualifiers like "typical" or "about". Do not promise exact savings. Required privacy blurb on gated form: "By registering you agree to receive communications from Redwood Inference. See https://redwood.com/privacy."

Ops Bot: For routing slide include sample CSV export columns: timestamp,email,company,company_size,route_tag,utm_source. Notify channel #leads-webinar and email ops@redwood.com. Add PII handling note in PDF.

Riley (design-ops): Will follow brand tokens: primary #0A74FF, accent #0B6FD8, bg #F4F7FB. Accessibility: text contrast >=4.5:1, headers 22px semibold, body 14px. Dark-mode variants included.

Maya Chen: Great. Owners: Riley design; Kam product for data; Diego paid; Legal Bot signoff; Ops Bot routing. Ping here when Figma is up and drop export package.

Riley (design-ops): Dropping first frames in Figma now under /marketing/launch/benchmark-kit. I'll @Legal Bot in comments for quick review. Checklist I'll attach: hero (1920x1080 x2 headlines), comparator chart (PNG + SVG + animated), 3 tiles (1080x1080 + 1200x628), routing slide (PPTX + PNG), 1-page sales PDF, alt text + localization CSV.

Diego (demand-gen): Will QA paid specs once assets are in. GIF should loop cleanly and be under 2s.

Maya Chen: Thanks team 44d. Once legal signs off, I'll queue them for the webinar partner.
